content.text:
---database.yml---
default: &default
  adapter: postgresql
  encoding: unicode
  pool: <%= ENV.fetch("RAILS_MAX_THREADS") { 5 } %>
  host: <%= ENV.fetch('APP_DB_HOST') { '127.0.0.1' } %>
  username: <%= ENV.fetch("APP_DB_USERNAME") { "samarbeid" } %>
  password: <%= ENV.fetch('APP_DB_PASSWORD') { 'samarbeid' } %>
  database: <%= ENV.fetch("APP_DB_DATABASE") { "samarbeid_#{Rails.env}" } %>

development:
  <<: *default

test:
  <<: *default
  database: samarbeid_test

production:
  <<: *default
---DB USER QUERY---
 id |       email       | role 
----+-------------------+------
  1 | admin@example.org |    2
(1 row)

observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "---database.yml---" && cat config/database.yml 2>&1 | head -30; echo "---DB USER QUERY---"; PGPASSWORD=samarbeid psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U samarbeid -d samarbeid_development -c "select id,email,role from users;" 2>&1 || sudo -u postgres psql -d samarbeid_development -c "select id,email,role from users;" 2>&1
